root.label: August 2026 unemployment rates by education and age

events.label: August 2026 unemployment rates by education and age

slots.name: bachelor unemployment rate
slots.sentence: As of August 2026, the unemployment rate for people ages 25-34 with a bachelor's degree was 3.4%.

slots.name: high school unemployment rate
slots.sentence: For high school graduates of the same age, it was 6.2%, according to federal government data.

slots.name: associate unemployment rate
slots.sentence: What stands out: In August, the unemployment rate among workers of the same age with an associate degree in occupational programs that prepared them for a specific job was 2.2% — nearly half the national rate of 4.1%.
